# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before writing or editing any code in a Widdx
project. It is the complete, authoritative handbook — one atomic fact per line:
PART 0 = the five-command start, PART 2 = golden rules, PART 4 = what the framework
infers from names, PART 21 = known pitfalls, PART 22 = "user asks for X → you write Y".

Do not restate its facts here. This file only points at it, so the handbook stays the
single source of truth.
